initial_decision.brief_rationale: Promotion probability is 0.8 in both exposure groups, giving an observed difference of zero. The received evidence does not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R135-2 to assess whether the causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: Both observed promotion risks equal 0.8, giving a descriptive difference of zero. R135-2 supplies consistency and no interference but no condition identifying the counterfactual risks. The average causal risk difference is therefore not uniquely determined.
